author: Inside Edition
description: Novelist Harlan Coben, who has built an empire around his best-selling books, is known for his plot twists. He is also the host of "Harlan Coben's Final Twist," a true-crime show which starts its second season Monday night on CBS and Paramount Plus, the parent company of Inside Edition. The first episode of the new season centers on the slaying of church-going mom Betsy Faria in her Missouri home in 2011. Coben spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: True Crime Novelist Harlan Coben Talks About New Season Of His TV Show -

author: Inside Edition
description: There's a bombshell development in the alleged drugging and gang rape of a Cornell university student. For the very first time, we are hearing a secretly recorded phone call between 'Jane Doe' and one of the frat members who allegedly sexually assaulted her. She has sued seven frat members. They have denied wrongdoing or criminal conduct on the night of the alleged attack. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano has the details.
title: Jane Doe Secretly Recorded Phone Call With Frat Member She Says Sexually Assaulted Her

author: Inside Edition
description: An AI-generated video of a man named Chris Pelkey addressing his killer at his sentencing is making legal history. The voice and likeness is that of the slain army veteran. Gabriel Horcasitas was convicted of manslaughter after he shot Pelkey in a road rage dispute at a red light in Chandler, Arizona. Now, the Arizona state Court of Appeals has thrown out Horcasitas' sentencing, finding that the AI video was "fundamentally unfair" to the defendant.
title: Court Says AI-Generated 'Dead Man' Shouldn't Have Spoken At His Killer's Sentencing

author: Inside Edition
description: A man planned the perfect surprise proposal at a romantic spot overlooking Laguna Beach in southern California. He even hired a mariachi band for the special moment. All was going according to plan, until a woman showed up and started yelling ugly, racist things at them. The disturbing confrontation was caught on camera by a photographer hired by the groom-to-be. Inside Edition's Jim Moret is there.
title: Laguna Beach 'Karen' Interrupts Proposal With Racist Outburst

author: Inside Edition
description: Dakota Johnson hosted "Saturday Night Live" over the weekend. After joking about her love life, Johnson shocked viewers with a surprise guest: Taylor Swift. The pop star made a cameo for Johnson's 37th birthday. Swift came back out at the end of the show with a birthday cake for Johnson. Meanwhile, just five weeks after leaving her position as White House press secretary, Karoline Leavitt has been hired by Fox News as a contributor.
title: Taylor Swift Makes Surprise Appearance On 'Saturday Night Live'

author: Inside Edition
description: Heidi Widmer had just moved into her new Culver City, California apartment when she started hearing strange noises from the apartment above her. She decided to investigate, she and discovered that her elderly neighbor Carole needed some help. Heidi stepped up for Carole, who has Parkinson's Disease; she helped the 86-year-old get new appliances for her apartment, and she organized a GoFundMe campaign to benefit her. Inside Edition's Jim Moret spoke to both women.
title: The Strange Noises Woman Heard Above Her Came From Elderly Neighbor Needing Help

author: Inside Edition
description: Remington Weckbacher shares his story about surviving a catastrophic orphan well explosion that killed two others and left him with severe burns over most of his body.
title: Well Explosion Burned Nearly 80 Percent Of Ohio Man's Body #shorts
